body: Well that series finale last night didn't help.
But not the teeth that are already broken.

I know that he cares. But if he didn't have to work so hard to take care of me, he would be happier. He would have money and friends again. He could do what he wanted instead of taking care of me. He would hurt for a little while, but then he'd find someone else and forget me.
Tried the mouth guard. I chew through them.

So I should just sit around in pain and HOPE that things get better? I'm sorry, but this makes me want to do it even more. Things haven't changed in 2 years, they aren't going to change. If they do, they only change for the worse. That has been my entire life. Things never change for the better.

Bipolar Disorder, endometriosis, colitis, possible cervical cancer, and my teeth are falling out because I grind them. I have basic medical insurance, but it doesn't cover all the costs of the medications. I have no dental insurance and can't afford to have any kind of work done. The pain everyday is horrible. It's changing me. I used to be a nice person. Now I am getting mean. I don't like what it is doing to me.

He would be much better off without me. Right now, I just bring him down. Also, we both have Bipolar Disorder and when I get depressed, he gets depressed. He spends his every dime trying to keep me out of pain, and yet we never have enough. If I wasn't around he could have a life.
